annotations.title: Fetch EU document by EUR-Lex URL

description: Fetch a parsed document from any EUR-Lex URL — useful when the user pastes a link from their browser. Extracts the CELEX from the URL and returns the same shape as lex_get_document plus sourceUrl and extractedCelex echoes.

url.description: Any eur-lex.europa.eu URL containing a CELEX: identifier or uri= parameter.

name: lex_get_document_by_url
